# VoxCPM 0.5B

OpenBMB · released 2025-09 · apache-2.0

**score 58.8** ±1.4 · #24 of 46 · from 15 benchmark results across 3 sources

Score within the [Vapi Humanness · Bradley–Terry rating, 2026-09-25 snapshot](https://whatmodel.sh/tts?set=vapi-humanness-bt-20260925&score=set) comparison set only.

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<pre>
version             needs  score
bf16 · nvidia only   ~5GB   58.8
</pre>

```sh
# bf16 · nvidia only
pip install voxcpm && voxcpm design --text "Hello, world." --hf-model-id openbmb/VoxCPM-0.5B --output out.wav
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
